subject: Client reference capture: discovery call + agenda & recording permission
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medinex.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Client reference capture: discovery call + agenda & recording permission

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for agreeing to help with a short case profile about Medinex's rollout. We want to keep this light (30–40 minutes) and focus on outcomes and the operational playbook you used — nothing technical that would affect IP. High-level goals for the call:

- Capture measurable outcomes (latency/cost improvements, time-to-serve gains)
- Understand stakeholders and internal adoption plan
- Surface any lessons learned and quotes for a short customer story

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Wed 16 Jun — 10:00–10:40
- Wed 16 Jun — 14:00–14:40
- Thu 17 Jun — 11:00–11:40

We plan to record for internal note-taking and to produce a 1–2 page case brief. If you prefer not to be recorded, we can take notes and send a transcript summary for approval. Attached is a short prep doc and a list of suggested questions.

Attachments: medinex_case_qs_v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

If any other stakeholders should join (e.g., engineering lead, procurement), let me know and we’ll schedule accordingly.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

--
Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medinex.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@medinex.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Client reference capture: discovery call + agenda & recording permission

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for the note and the prep doc. Aaron (our Director of ML Ops) will join. We can do Wed 16 Jun at 14:00 PDT — that works best for our team.

Recording permission: Aaron prefers that the call be recorded for his own notes, and I’m fine with the session being recorded as long as we review the final brief before any external publication. Please confirm that Redwood will send a transcript and the draft case brief for approval before publishing.

Also: a couple of quick items to surface ahead of time:
- We may want to avoid specific dollar figures in the public brief — we can provide ranges or percent improvements instead.
- There’s a brief procurement checklist that needs sign-off if we reference contractual timelines.

Looking forward to the conversation. Please send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product Insights, Medinex
lena.ortiz@medinex.com

- Redwood: prepare transcript + draft and send for approval within 3 business days after the call.
